about: Mira test suite. Each case is a scripted customer. 'user' is what the customer says, 'mira' is a fixed earlier Mira line (not tested), and 'check' is a live Mira reply that the judge scores against the given requirement plus the global rules in tests/run_evals.py. 'prefix' replays a standard opening so a case starts at the right point of the call. Set 'tuning' is used to fix the prompt; set 'heldout' was held out from the first fixes; set 'fresh' was written before any of its cases were run and is only run once, at the very end.
